explanation: OEIS A239957, Z.-W. Sun conjecture (i): 'every prime p has a primitive root 0 < g < p of the form k^2 + 1, where k is an integer.' The formal predicate asks for an integer k with k² + 1 < p (so 0 < g < p automatically) whose residue has multiplicative order p − 1 in ZMod p, i.e. is a primitive root. The statement is for all primes p (p = 2 works with g = 1). Faithful.
